verdict.rationale: ROS 2 provides typed topic interfaces meant for streaming sensor data, shared message definitions that let packages interoperate without glue code, a driver ecosystem, and name remapping. Together these let a component that publishes the same standard messages stand in for another without application changes. However, the pack never documents a dedicated hardware-abstraction layer for sensors and actuators, nor a hands-on driver swap. Missing for 10: a documented hardware-abstraction or controller framework for actuators, explicit docs on swapping hardware drivers without app changes, and hands-on corroboration of such a swap.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can swap sensors and actuators behind stable hardware-abstraction interfaces without rewriting application code
